verdict.rationale: OneDrive docs show shared folders, external sharing, and createLink sharing-link creation (which supports view-only style links) plus version history and change tracking that could support activity visibility. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'view-only'/no-download toggle or a dedicated access/audit-visibility report for diligence-style data rooms, and community threads focus on sync/reliability issues rather than data-room use. Missing for 10: explicit download-blocking controls on shared links, and dedicated access-log/audit visibility for shared folders.
